analysis: BrentOptimizer tests compare exact floating-point results across changes to accuracy defaults and iteration logic. The representative start value is outside its interval. A tiny numerical difference is not sufficient defect evidence without interval-contract and tolerance analysis.
scope: Existing tests and evidence only; no new benchmark execution. Frozen Java checksums and both fixed/buggy JUnit repetitions verified. Representative failing source and pinned source patch inspected, not an exhaustive assessment of every assertion. AI assessment is not human confirmation.
patch_direction: Defects4J source patch transforms fixed into buggy; minus lines are fixed-side code.
